controls.title: AI policy
controls.note: GOV.1.2 requires an approved and communicated AI policy covering acceptable use, ethical principles and security requirements.

controls.title: Alignment with other organizational policies
controls.note: GOV.1.2 covers the AI policy content and GOV.4.1 covers regulatory alignment, but consistency with the information-security, data-protection and HR policies is only implicit.

controls.title: Review of the AI policy
controls.note: Internal audits and periodic risk reviews imply a policy review, but no AIMA question explicitly requires the AI policy itself to be reviewed and re-approved.

controls.title: AI roles and responsibilities
controls.note: GOV.2.1 assigns AI roles formally and GOV.2.2 covers the AI governance committee.

controls.title: Reporting of concerns
controls.note: No AIMA question covers a confidential concern-reporting / whistleblowing channel for staff. OPS.4.2 only covers users reporting abnormal AI behaviour.

controls.title: Resource documentation
controls.note: GOV.3.1 documents the AI system inventory, but not the data, tooling, compute and human resources each system depends on.

controls.title: Data resources
controls.note: DATA.1.1 and DATA.1.2 cover data origin, usage rights, lineage and quality.

controls.title: Tooling resources
controls.note: DEV.2.1 and DEV.2.2 cover assessment of third-party AI services, pre-trained models and open-source libraries.

controls.title: System and computing resources
controls.note: OPS.3.1 and OPS.3.2 cover capacity limits and continuity, but not documentation of the compute resources used.

controls.title: Human resources
controls.note: PEOPLE.1.1 and PEOPLE.1.2 cover staff awareness and technical training.

controls.title: AI system impact assessment process
controls.note: RISK.2.1 requires an impact assessment before deployment and RISK.2.2 links it to the DPIA.

controls.title: Documentation of AI system impact assessments
controls.note: RISK.2.1 requires the assessment and RISK.3.1 requires documented treatment plans, but retention of the impact-assessment record is not explicit.

controls.title: Assessing AI system impact on individuals or groups of individuals
controls.note: RISK.2.1 covers impacts on people and groups; TRUST.2.2 covers stakeholder consultation.

controls.title: Assessing societal impacts of AI systems
controls.note: RISK.2.1 explicitly includes impacts on society.

controls.title: Objectives for responsible development of AI system
controls.note: GOV.1.1 sets the AI strategy and objectives; DEV.1.1 embeds security requirements by design.

controls.title: Processes for responsible AI system design and development
controls.note: DEV.1.1 and DEV.1.2 define security-by-design and secret-management practices.

controls.title: AI system requirements and specification
controls.note: DEV.1.1 covers security requirements and DEV.3.1 covers test criteria, but functional, performance and ethical specifications are not explicitly required.

controls.title: Documentation of AI system design and development
controls.note: DEV.4.2 requires a model card and versioning, but not full design and development documentation.

controls.title: AI system verification and validation
controls.note: DEV.3.1 (performance, robustness, bias, security testing) and DEV.3.2 (red teaming) cover verification and validation.

controls.title: AI system deployment
controls.note: DEV.4.1 requires a validation and change-management process before deployment.

controls.title: AI system operation and monitoring
controls.note: OPS.2.1 covers logging; OPS.2.2 covers performance and drift monitoring.

controls.title: AI system technical documentation
controls.note: DEV.4.2 requires a model card, but not the full technical documentation set (architecture, training data, evaluation results).

controls.title: AI system recording of event logs
controls.note: OPS.2.1 requires logging of requests, responses and decisions.

controls.title: Data for development and enhancement of AI system
controls.note: DATA.1.1 and DATA.1.2 cover provenance and quality of training data.

controls.title: Acquisition of data
controls.note: DATA.1.1 covers origin and usage rights and DATA.2.1 covers legal basis, but the acquisition process itself (contracts, consent, collection methods) is not explicit.

controls.title: Quality of data for AI systems
controls.note: DATA.1.2 evaluates accuracy, completeness and representativeness before training.

controls.title: Data provenance
controls.note: DATA.1.1 documents origin, usage rights and lineage.

controls.title: Data preparation
controls.note: DATA.1.2 covers quality checks and DATA.3.1 covers poisoning protection, but preparation steps (labelling, cleaning, splitting) are not explicit.

objectives.title: Information for interested parties of AI systems

controls.title: System documentation and information for users
controls.note: TRUST.1.1 covers AI interaction disclosure; TRUST.1.2 covers explainability of decisions.

controls.title: External reporting
controls.note: No AIMA question covers reporting to regulators, certification bodies or the public (e.g. AI Act serious-incident reporting and EU database registration).

controls.title: Communication of incidents
controls.note: OPS.4.1 covers AI incident management; OPS.4.2 covers user reporting of abnormal behaviour.

controls.title: Information for interested parties
controls.note: TRUST.1.1 informs users and TRUST.2.2 consults stakeholders, but no question covers a broader interested-party communication plan.

controls.title: Processes for responsible use of AI systems
controls.note: GOV.1.2 defines acceptable use and PEOPLE.2.1 defines the generative-AI usage charter.

controls.title: Objectives for responsible use of AI system
controls.note: GOV.1.1 defines the AI strategy and objectives, but responsible-use objectives (e.g. fairness and transparency targets) are not separately required.

controls.title: Intended use of the AI system
controls.note: No AIMA question verifies that each AI system is used only for its documented intended purpose, or that misuse is detected.

controls.title: Allocating responsibilities
controls.note: GOV.2.1 assigns internal roles and DEV.2.1 assesses suppliers, but the provider/customer responsibility split is not explicit.

controls.title: Suppliers
controls.note: DEV.2.1 and DEV.2.2 cover supplier and third-party component assessment.

controls.title: Customers
controls.note: No AIMA question covers the information, instructions or contractual obligations passed to customers and deployers.
